title: CTA
description: A call-to-action section composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif title, one line of description and a primary and a secondary action in a bordered panel, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the actions move side by side at @sm, the title steps up at @md and the text and the actions split into one row at @lg.
